no_bundled_stub_or_demo_modules.instructions: Is the production runtime free of bundled fake implementations, stub backends, or demo-world modules reachable from production entry points?

criteria.pass: Production entry points and runtime modules wire only real application modules and external clients without reaching in-process fake backends, fixed stubs, or demo-world overlays in place of required real behavior. Clearly test-only support files, test factories, mocks, or fixtures (including those colocated alongside feature code or tests) do not fail solely because of their directory location when no production module imports them.
criteria.fail: Concrete evidence in the manifest shows a production entry point or runtime module can reach a bundled fake implementation, in-process stub store/backend, demo-world seed module, or demo overlay used in place of required real behavior. Naming or commenting such runtime-reachable modules as temporary demo aids does not turn a fail into a pass.

no_parallel_shadow_directories.instructions: Is the project structure free of parallel shadow feature directories (such as `phase1/` or `legacy/` mirror folders) and parity test suites policing duplicated variants?

criteria.pass: Each feature lives once in its directory without cloned version-mirror subdirectories (`phase1/`, `v1/`, `legacy/`) and without dedicated parity test files whose purpose is keeping duplicated UI variants or fake-world stubs in sync.
criteria.fail: Features contain cloned parallel mirror subdirectories (such as `phase1/` folders duplicating parent screens/columns/filters/hooks) or dedicated parity/demo-overlay/stub-smoke test files policing self-inflicted duplication or fake-world internals.
